calculation_source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256,receipt

files=[Path('results/kaggle/original-v1')/name for name in ['sft_config.json','grpo_config.json']]
configs={}
for path in files:
 data=json.loads(path.read_text())
 configs[str(path)]={'sha256':file_sha256(path),'outer_seed':data['seed'],
   'trainer_seed':data['trainer_config']['seed'],'trainer_data_seed':data['trainer_config'].get('data_seed')}
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'correct original trainer-seed interpretation from downloaded configs'},'3764fa359b9082ea5a1e4a5e3ac3aaf6e9671636'),
 'kernel':'nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-grpo-qwen3','version':1,'configs':configs,
 'lora_initialization_seed':0,'prompt_shuffle_seed':0,
 'actual_sft_trainer_seed':3407,'actual_grpo_trainer_seed':3407,
 'trainer_data_seed':None,
 'correction':'The original hard-coded outer seed 0 does not describe the trainer RNG seed. Both downloaded trainer configs specify 3407. Preserve all original files and raw episode provenance; this record corrects their interpretation. The frozen-adapter continuation seed 0 is an evaluation-process seed, not retraining.',
 'source_sha256':file_sha256('train/kaggle/grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py'),
 'calculation_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
assert all(v['trainer_seed']==3407 for v in configs.values())
Path('results/training/original_seed_correction.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_original_completion.json');data=json.loads(p.read_text());data['seed_correction']='results/training/original_seed_correction.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_original_final_resume.json');data=json.loads(p.read_text());data['training_seed_correction']='results/training/original_seed_correction.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
